title: Bagi xagana
intro: tibba le footimaamih addat sorkocobaxi qibaadah, diini xagana yunbulle. ta xagana fanteena abte mano uxih ufuy rubtaah, tet kibne roociini raatih korsi amotani milaagele. maaqatta mistirih rooci xagni kak amotani qagaaqagitak.
clues: Anu elle mannoowam buxah addal taqwa kinnim tamixxigeeh, Yalla fan yoo xayyossah tan acwah qaago liyo.
Anu inni addat qeltut tanim wagittaamal yi Rabbi lih gibdi xagana abeeh, inkitanuuk kay ayfaafah aceem xagana culeh an.
fakkiimeh yan uddur yemeete wak, anu geem qammalsimak masuginna, takkay immay anu caagid kullim yaaxige numuh aamineh.
Anu inni baxah diini baxxaqisa migaq eceeh, tet kee tet samad abaarot yan numuk kalaluh xaaqimeh.
Yi baxi diini aracal daffeyeh suge, Aaron samadak nabiyyih dacrisah gubat.
Yi baxa saytunnowteh sugteeh, inkih tan sayyoh addal doorimteeh, lakal kaxxa nabiyyih ina tekke, takkay immay raqteh sugte.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Ubka sinni alqi qibaadah aracal taceemih xagana
Xer baaxo fan aban safar Iimaan sabbatah.
trial.answer: Ubka sinni alqi qibaadah aracal taceemih xagana

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Tet baxi yalli oggoleh nabiiyô hanaawih gubat yenbe.
Tet baxi nabiyyi yekkeeh kutbe hirge
Tet baxi diini qari xiseh yan
Tet baxi mango wale kee gadda gee
outcome.answer: Tet baxi yalli oggoleh nabiiyô hanaawih gubat yenbe.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
